title: Define the infinite-place index of the Fock signs
reason: The formula introduces Σ without defining it and then refers to signs “at the real places.” A CM field E has no real embeddings. The index in the source is (v,i) with v an infinite place of E, carrying sign εᵢ.
proposed_correction: Define Σ as the infinite places of E, equivalently the real places of its maximal totally real subfield, and assign sign εᵢ to (v,i).

title: Name the polynomial differentiated to obtain the different generator
reason: In “P be parameters … g=P′(ζ)” the symbol P already denotes the parameter tuple. No polynomial P has been introduced, so the derivative used in the lattice criterion cannot be read literally.
proposed_correction: Write g=Φ′_{q₁}(ζ), with Φ_{q₁} the q₁-th cyclotomic polynomial.

title: The title turns an upper bound into equality
reason: The result is val₆(ν) ≤ 0. Strict inequality occurs under these hypotheses: at an inert p > 2 use a singleton coupling family with exponent 1 and multiplicity 1. The normal form along the frame and the six-copy coupling bound give val₆(p[τ] + [τ⁺]) ≤ −1.
proposed_correction: Title the result “Nonpositive least valuation along a tight frame at an inert prime” and use the same wording for the area-page link.

title: Attribute the factorial interval estimate to the project library
reason: The parenthetical “Mathlib” identifies the wrong source. New.padicValNat_factorial_mem_Icc is a lemma proved in this development from Legendre’s digit-sum formula.
proposed_correction: Cite New.padicValNat_factorial_mem_Icc in Lib/General/Algebra/IntegralPowerSeries.lean in References, or omit the parenthetical and retain the self-contained digit-sum proof.

title: Correct the isogeny citation for the area equality
reason: The principal bridge left to the source is cited as New.CMLattice.exists_isIsogeny_of_mul_mem_lattice. That qualified name does not exist. The result for period pairs lies in New, as does its companion in ConjugateCurve.
proposed_correction: Cite New.exists_isIsogeny_of_mul_mem_lattice and New.conj_isogeny_mul_mem_lattice. The latter applies to the identity isogeny and gives inclusion of the corresponding period lattices.

title: Identify the space carrying the inner product
reason: The introduction calls the pairing the inner product of V. Its arguments are vectors of the complex function space 𝒮(V), whereas V itself carries a Hermitian form over E.
proposed_correction: Call it the inner product on 𝒮(V) and retain the quotient-mean formula for its value on (f,f).

title: The integer-product valuation lemma is assigned to the wrong knowl
reason: The metadata and References assign norm_natCast_prod_eq_rpow_neg_sum to this page. Its proof uses the product of coefficients on disjoint variables. The separate identity for p-adic norms of natural-number products is used for the loss products and factorials in the final sharpness theorem, and is absent from the reduction page.
proposed_correction: Move that secondary Lean declaration and its reference to sharpness-of-the-valuation-bound, whose last step presents both applications.

title: The displayed definition divides by an allowed zero
reason: The knowl defines wᵢ/ν for every ν in ℕ. At ν = 0 this is undefined in ordinary field notation, while Lean uses total division and returns the zero vector. The theorem immediately below only uses positive denominators.
proposed_correction: Specify ν > 0 and b,k positive integers in the textbook formulation, or state the zero-vector convention when ν = 0.

title: Specify the weight at which the local prime sum is evaluated
reason: The text calls Sₚ the predicted valuation while the theorem varies the order l. The local prime sum takes an order as an argument. Lean uses Sₚ = ∑τ sₚ(κ(τ),τ), which is independent of l throughout the interval.
proposed_correction: Put the formula for Sₚ after the inequality and identify sₚ as the local prime sum.

title: Use the same index for the distinguished copy across the six-copy arguments
reason: The summary calls the distinguished scale δ₀, while the one-based text calls it δ₁. Either indexing proves this theorem, but the linked coupling argument later singles out factor 0 while quoting the δ₁ convention.
proposed_correction: Index this six-tuple as δ₀,…,δ₅ with δ₀=1 in both the summary and body, or explicitly state the relabelling wherever it is used.

title: Identify the norm-pair closure in the cited integrality theorem
reason: The source assumes membership in the closure of (ιₚα, ιₚ(α times its conjugate)) for all integers α of K. The page attributes to it the smaller closure of the natural-integer pairs (k,k²). This specialization suffices here, but it omits the domain of the cited result.
proposed_correction: Give the norm-pair closure from the source, then note that it contains (a,a²) for a ∈ ℤₚ by density of the natural integers.

title: Handle a zero vacuum value before taking its logarithm
reason: The estimate is quantified over every y. Positivity of the integer factor gives no positivity of the vacuum value at that particular y, so the real logarithm in the proof requires a case distinction. Lean multiplies the separate exponential bounds directly.
proposed_correction: When the vacuum value vanishes, the inequality is immediate. Take logarithms in the remaining case, or multiply the exponential bounds for both factors.

title: Define the place of a nonunit for the unrestricted second assertion
reason: The page introduces [ν] only when ν is coprime to q₁. Item 2 as a separate implication also allows primes dividing q₁, so [−pᵉ] is undefined there for e>0 under the page’s notation. Lean sets the place to the identity in this case.
proposed_correction: Define [ν] for every integer ν, using its residue-class place if ν is a unit modulo q₁ and the identity place otherwise.

title: Cite the translated-vacuum formula for the displayed identity
reason: The named omega_vacElem_sum treats the untranslated vacuum and gives m(g)/|m(g)|². The displayed formula also moves h(x) across the Weil operator and writes the scalar as m(g⁻¹)⁻¹. Both additional identities are present in the source.
proposed_correction: Cite omega_finHeisenbergOp_intVacuum for this exact formula, or cite the covariance identity and m(g⁻¹) = conjugate(m(g)) alongside the vacuum sum.

title: The approximation lemma has a different namespace
reason: The point-approximation assertion is correct, but the link targets New.Space.exists_finiteImage_approx. The declaration is in namespace New, with Space opened locally.
proposed_correction: Point the approximation reference to New.exists_finiteImage_approx.

title: State the root-of-unity frame assumed by the large-length construction
reason: The inline lemma introduces neither ζ nor its relation to q₁ and the ambient field. Its proof requires that the q₁ powers of ζ themselves give a tight frame of length q₁ in the same lattice as v.
proposed_correction: Fix the parameters P and exponent s, introduce E=K(ζ) with ζ the chosen primitive q₁-th root, and link the root-of-unity frame lemma there.

title: The residue calculations are attributed to the wrong source
reason: The two results called Lib lemmas are proved in the derivatives-divisibility chapter, in NormalForm.lean at lines 394 and 411. Both already have a translated proof under coupling-sum-derivatives.
proposed_correction: Cite the derivatives-divisibility knowl coupling-sum-derivatives for the two residue computations.

title: The translation notation hides an idele factor
reason: Conditions 5 and 6 both use a subscript f without specifying how to embed the two inputs. For a finite adelic coordinate y, the argument is finVec(y) with finite part αy. For a rational vector γ, it is finVec(finiteImage(γ)) with finite part γ. Treating y as its own finite part changes the expansion at the components where α differs from 1.
proposed_correction: Define both subscripts before the conditions: (y)f is the adelic vector (0,αy), while γf is (0,γ), obtained from finite coordinate α⁻¹γ.

title: Keep the integral lattice as the summation index
reason: The rightmost sum suppresses the integrality condition and the following sentence calls the points γ_W separated. The introductory sum on line 30 ranges over Eⁿ. In positive rank the latter set contains e₁/j tending to zero, so an unrestricted exponential sum diverges and the packing bound cannot apply to it.
proposed_correction: Name the set of W-integral γ and retain it in both the last exponential sum and the application of the packing bound on line 34.

title: The class-points link resolves to a page without the definition
reason: The page claims the declaration classPoints but never introduces it. The upper-divisibility knowl on summing a chain refers to that declaration, so following the intended link here would not explain how representatives are used or what happens at the final coordinate.
proposed_correction: Add the definition that a tuple of classes supplies its chosen representative in slots j<m, with the original tuple retained in slots j≥m, or assign the declaration to the plain-sum knowl where this is already stated.

title: Identify the mixed bases for the mirror datum
reason: The lattice interpretation switches from original bases to two enlarged bases for the direct datum and then presents the mirror formula without specifying its bases. The mirror uses the original source L and the enlarged target L′⁺. In original bases a matrix T must first be replaced by D_N⁻¹T before the corner-character formula is applied.
proposed_correction: State explicitly that the matrix for the mirror formula is written in bases of L and L′⁺, and that u′ takes values modulo N.

title: The column formula uses truncated indices at actual heights
reason: The parenthesis says truncation only matters outside the range used. The valid step p=0 already evaluates k⁻ at height r+t−1>r in c(1), so both of its target-parameter indices truncate to zero. Without the convention these entries have negative indices.
proposed_correction: Keep the definition of truncated subtraction and drop the parenthesis, or give c(1) as an example of an in-range use.

title: Put both diagonal factors inside the place product
reason: In the printed formula, the dot follows the closing determinant power and the box product still depends on τ. The binding of τ over this second factor is unclear for a field with several infinite places.
proposed_correction: Enclose both factors in the outer product: ∏τ [(∏b |uτ,b|)^(e′τ) · ∏boxes of i′τ |uτ,entry|].

title: The chosen bijection also assigns grid coordinates
reason: The remark says the arbitrary bijection for positive block length is used only for counting. The grid uses it twice to define gridBlockEquiv, and then reads each coordinate’s sign and doubled parameter through that bijection in gridSigns and gridParam.
proposed_correction: Remove “used only for counting” and say that the same arbitrary relabeling assigns base and block coordinates for the grid data.

title: Correct the namespaces of the trace and integrability references
reason: Four entries beginning New.Form.levelTrace or New.Form.hasLevel/integral_levelTrace are defined inside namespace New.Space, and New.IsEquivariant.integrable_mul is defined inside New.Grading. The names in the declaration metadata do not resolve to the proof's lemmas.
proposed_correction: Use New.Space.Form.levelTrace, New.Space.Form.levelTrace_apply, New.Space.Form.hasLevel_levelTrace, New.Space.Form.integral_levelTrace_mul, and New.Grading.IsEquivariant.integrable_mul.

title: Supply the missing lower bound in the name of the unipotent subgroup
reason: The printed decomposition R₀=U^{≥}⋊U(X₀) leaves the filtration degree blank. The group in the period-equivariance lemma consists of u with u−1 raising degrees by at least two.
proposed_correction: Write U^{≥2} and optionally spell out the degree-raising condition.

title: Distinguish the rank of the group from the dimension of its coefficient module
reason: “The Weyl module … of rank k” reads as a dimension claim. Here k is the rank of the underlying hermitian space. At one a-place the coefficient module for (a,0,…,0) has a basis indexed by degree-a monomials in k variables, of dimension binomial(a+k−1,k−1).
proposed_correction: Call it the Weyl module for GL_k of the specified weight, reserving rank k for X₀.

title: The seven outline labels include a construction
reason: The totals 42 proof labels, 35 full and seven outline are correct. By the actual item kinds there are 39 lemmas, propositions or theorems, of which 33 are full and six are outlines. The extra three proof-bearing items are the definition of cover multiplicity and the constructions of the finite zero term and the seesaw datum.
proposed_correction: Write “of the 42 items with proof-status labels, 35 are full and seven are outlines”.

title: The scalar multiplying the zero-term constant is undefined
reason: K first appears in C=cK. The finite index it represents determines the normalization of the admissible combination and is only identifiable by following a later reference.
proposed_correction: Define K as the cardinality of the away quotient for X′⊔{e′} before setting C=cK.

title: The dependency's proof-status description is stale
reason: The remark calls zero-term-lattice an outline, but zero-term-lattice.knowl.md:12 labels it full in this snapshot. The separate block identity is the stated limitation on the present page.
proposed_correction: Update the dependency description to its current full status, or remove the status reference. Retain the identified limitation in the proof of the block identity.

title: Extend the pure finite tensor calculation by linearity
reason: Even when the real polynomial separates as P Q, the arbitrary finite tensor y in the complement need not be decomposable. The sentence that the datum is then a join of two pure tensors skips this distinction. Lean first handles y=Φ⊗Φ′ and then addition of finite tensors.
proposed_correction: Make the factorization for a pure finite tensor, absorbing the joining constant into the second real polynomial, and extend to arbitrary y by linearity.

title: The summary identifies the modulus norm with the conductor norm
reason: The formula in the body uses q=∏_{w∈Q} Nw and imposes its size bound for Q=∅. A TameChar carries an assigned Q that can include trivial tame factors, so its q need not be the character's conductor norm.
proposed_correction: Use ‘norm of the supplied modulus’ and ‘when this modulus is empty’ in the summary.

title: The displayed Heisenberg phase uses two undefined symbols
reason: The only occurrence of ψ and c₀ on the page is the formula for ζ_z. Its exact scalar depends on the self-dual character and the chosen trace-one adele.
proposed_correction: Identify ψ as the fixed self-dual additive character and c₀ as the integral adele with c₀+conj(c₀)=1 from the Weil data, or state only the root-of-unity consequence of the cited composition formula.

title: Specify the representatives used in y/N
reason: A component y_w belongs to ℤ/N, so division by N alone determines a class modulo integral elements. The page defines an actual adelic vector n(y). Changing an integer lift of y_w by N changes its component in y/N by 1.
proposed_correction: Use the integer representative in {0,…,N−1} in each component before dividing by N, as in the definition of residueOverN.

title: Use scalar pairings when writing phases for matrices
reason: The page uses x* for conjugate transpose, yet places x*x and y*x directly inside an additive character of the adeles. For matrices with multiple columns those products are matrices. The source applies its dot product to vectors indexed by all row-column pairs.
proposed_correction: For matrix arguments write ⟨y,x⟩=∑_{i,j}ȳ_{ij}x_{ij}=tr(y*x), and use this scalar in the composition, commutation, and semicharacter formulas.

title: The integrality identity drops the support idempotent
reason: With arbitrary integral lifts z_b, qt is the conjugate of 1_S·ϖₘ⁻¹(dq) z_{b,i}, where S consists of the primes of 𝔪. Omitting 1_S gives the wrong components away from conj(S), even though the integrality conclusion survives.
proposed_correction: Insert 1_S inside the conjugation in the formula for qt, and write y_b=conj(1_S·ϖₘ⁻¹ z_b) to make the order of restriction and conjugation explicit.

title: Keep the empty-modulus condition on both size bounds
reason: The statement records the correct condition, but the proof invokes a size of 1 for evaluated tensors and a size of C^m for the weighted cut without it. Both input results bound the absolute coefficient sums only when Q is empty.
proposed_correction: Attach “when Q is empty” to both size estimates in lines 60–62 and retain the denominator estimates for every Q.

title: Distinguish the finite frame from the finite group point
reason: In the theorem x_f labels the finite part of the variable adelic point. Here x_f becomes the fixed frame of the space, the variable is renamed p, and line 66 again uses r x_f for the group point. The fixed frame can lie outside the finite unitary group.
proposed_correction: Use B and B′ for the fixed frames and p=x_f, p′=x′_f for the variable group points throughout. Then W=(B′p′)[l](Bp)⁻¹ and its source lattice at the translated point is Λ_{rp}.

title: Give the distinguished coordinate a separate subscript
reason: The notation y₀ denotes the coordinate on the distinguished non-string vector and also y_b at b=0 on the string. When s=1, the middle test on line 31 therefore appears to subtract two multiples of the same variable, although the source takes coordinates at two different basis indices.
proposed_correction: Write y_e for the distinguished non-string coordinate and y_{z_b} for the string coordinates, including in the solved basis coefficients.

title: Disambiguate the coordinate changed in the lift
reason: The lift changes z₀ while keeping the string coordinate z_c fixed. For a one-vector string c=0, so lines 52–53 use z₀ for both the changed distinguished coordinate and the unchanged string coordinate. Lean updates only the extra basis index outside the string.
proposed_correction: Call the extra coordinate z_e, put z_e=πη, and retain z_{z_b}=y_{z_b} for every string index b. Use the same convention for y_e in part 3.

title: The level places include all of the assigned modulus
reason: The last assertion calls Q the ramification set. The defining condition requires trivial tame factors outside Q only. LevelIdeles.lean:140 takes a level that also imposes reduction at unramified places deliberately included in Q.
proposed_correction: Use ‘a tame character with chosen modulus Q’ and describe the input as globally integral, reducing to one at the chosen places and equal to one at every place of Q.

title: Absorb the double-unfolding scalar into the archimedean factor
reason: The preceding identity gives z times the double integral for v. Applying the complement to v alone yields a coefficient of the unscaled integral. The source applies the complement to z v to get exactly the original unfolding function.
proposed_correction: Apply the definite-lift identity to z v, or multiply the resulting linear functional by z. Note that z is independent of the character and the finite points.

title: Separate the terminal global function from the restricted recurrence
reason: The recursive bullet defines W^R_{k+1} without a bound on k. The restricted functions are defined only through k+1≤m−1. The unrestricted W_m still exists from the last unfolding with a chosen length-zero grading of Y_m.
proposed_correction: Give the index ranges explicitly: W^R_k for 0≤k≤m−1 and W_{k+1} for 0≤k≤m−1. At the last unrestricted step use the last grading of Y_m.

title: The chapter contains seven items carrying a full proof label
reason: The statement that all proofs are outlines conflicts with the actual item metadata: three lemmas, three propositions and a construction are marked full. One is the identity summing the gains cited in this very chapter.
proposed_correction: Describe the principal divisibility and size theorems as outlines relative to named inputs and leave the individual proof labels in force.

title: The diagram away from the a-places is empty at rank k
reason: The phrase “no column of height below k except of height k” suggests that a height-k column might contribute. The diagram sums only over h<k. At a non-a-place even the height-one count is zero, so the factor is the degree-zero symmetric power.
proposed_correction: State that the diagram used by the Schur matrix on X₀ is empty at a non-a-place. Cite the height cutoff in diagramWeight and the degree-zero calculation at HeckeEdges.lean lines 675–683 in place of the uncertainty in the status note.

title: The last numerical inequality also uses a lower bound on log x₁
reason: The single relation L⁶≤log b with L=log x₁ does not by itself imply 16L(1+L)≤log b. For example L=log b=1 satisfies the former inequality and violates the latter.
proposed_correction: Use the available scale bound L≥3 to give 16L(1+L)≤L⁶≤log b, or cite the full size comparison as done in Estimates.lean:393.

title: Two quoted proof inputs have incorrect declaration names
reason: The coefficient substitution uses New.Seesaw.IsAdmissibleCombination and its bind lemma. The commutation cited on line 26 is New.Space.omega_projOn in VacuumProjections.lean, line 587. Both links omit their intermediate namespace.
proposed_correction: Link to the existing upper-seesaw/admissible-combination-substitution page for regrouping and use New.Space.omega_projOn for the commutation.

title: The short-basis theorem is cited under the wrong namespace
reason: The quoted input supplying integral g⁻¹Y and the bound at every complex embedding is New.Space.exists_short_basis_stdSpace. The current link targets New.exists_short_basis_stdSpace.
proposed_correction: Point the citation to New.Space.exists_short_basis_stdSpace.

title: The natural-number domain includes undefined loss and exponent formulas
reason: The page explicitly includes p=0 in the preceding clause, then uses a/p and ceil(2mfa/p). The ceiling logarithm is described only for p>1, leaving the transfer exponent unspecified at 0 and 1. The source defines all these functions on natural numbers.
proposed_correction: Either present the formulas only for primes or explicitly state the source conventions for division by zero and the degenerate bases of the ceiling logarithm.

title: The base-p logarithm is undefined at two admitted inputs
reason: The page quantifies over natural p, including 0 and 1. Its displayed ordinary logarithm to base p is undefined there, whereas the source uses the total real logb.
proposed_correction: Restrict the mathematical presentation to p prime, or supply the total logarithm convention at p=0 and p=1 for the extension to natural indices.

title: The pole entries require a representative of each residue class
reason: At this point y is a residue modulo N. Writing −y/N does not specify an element of the local field. Replacing a representative by y+N changes the adelic translation tuple by an integral vector. The source takes the integer representative in [0,N) before dividing.
proposed_correction: Specify this lift in the definition and form the conjugate of its adelic column for the last row. Link the pole column and row to New.Seesaw.poleColumn and New.Seesaw.poleRow, both already on the upper-objects chain-datum-and-composite-lift page.

title: The quoted Heisenberg composition law has the wrong namespace
reason: The phase law used to combine the disjoint translates is New.Space.finHeisenbergOp_finHeisenbergOp. The current reference, New.finHeisenbergOp_finHeisenbergOp, does not identify that declaration.
proposed_correction: Use the fully qualified name New.Space.finHeisenbergOp_finHeisenbergOp.

title: State the domain or the positive part of the gauge factor
reason: The definition given for raising by C omits the source's factor max(C,0). For C < 0 even the zero kernel fails the displayed prose definition on a nonzero input, whereas it belongs to the source's additive submonoid for every C. The proposition uses positive factors p^{r_j}.
proposed_correction: Restrict the explanatory definition to C ≥ 0 or use max(C,0) for arbitrary real C.

title: The mirabolic references name the wrong namespace
reason: The links for the group in the statement and for the two ingredients in the status paragraph use New.mirabolic, New.directDatum and New.exists_inclGL_eq. All three belong to New.IsSplitLevel, and their existing knowls use that qualified namespace.
proposed_correction: Use New.IsSplitLevel.mirabolic, New.IsSplitLevel.directDatum and New.IsSplitLevel.exists_inclGL_eq, or link the existing mirabolic-subgroup-at-split-level and data-modulo-n knowls.

title: The displayed gain terms need the partner-exponent restriction
reason: The text extends the preceding inequality outside I_p by saying its left side then vanishes. For example e=0 is excluded, but at an a-place the displayed positive part (a−w(u(−1)τ)) is positive. Lean explicitly sets each gain summand to zero outside I_p and likewise restricts the full geometric summand.
proposed_correction: Sum the displayed inequality only over e in I_p, or insert the indicator of I_p on all gain and full geometric terms before extending it to all natural exponents.

title: Supply the parameter-specific reason that p avoids q₁
reason: Inertness gives p ∤ q₁ here because every prime divisor of this particular q₁ splits in K. The proof asserts this implication immediately and its link for unramifiedness names New.intValuation_natCast_eq_exp_neg_one, whose actual namespace is New.Parameters.
proposed_correction: Cite New.Parameters.not_dvd_q₁_mul_d_of_inert for the coprimality and New.Parameters.intValuation_natCast_eq_exp_neg_one for v_l(p), or link the existing decomposition-of-primes-in-e knowl.

title: The summary reads as an exact codimension
reason: “All but a proportion f/(N−1)” gives the impression of equality. The source bounds the dimension from below by (1−f/(N−1)) times the full dimension, as part 4 of the page correctly states.
proposed_correction: Say that the codimension is at most a proportion f/(N−1) of the source dimension.

title: The operator defining A′ links to a nonexistent declaration
reason: U is introduced only by reference to New.upOperator. Its definition and the existing operator knowl use New.IsSplitLevel.upOperator, so the reference cannot resolve to the operator needed to interpret the preimage.
proposed_correction: Link proofs/grh/upper-objects/up-operator or use the fully qualified declaration New.IsSplitLevel.upOperator.

title: Several quoted estimates omit parts of their declaration names
reason: The two delta-form estimates are New.Rows.weylGauge_deltaForm_le and New.Rows.weylNormSq_deltaForm_le. The short-basis theorem on line 23 belongs to New.Space, and the p-adic Schur bound on line 31 belongs to New.Rows. The named declarations are the external inputs the outline asks the reader to consult.
proposed_correction: Use New.Rows for the two delta-form estimates and norm_schur_mulVec_le, and New.Space for exists_short_basis_stdSpace.

title: The cited row bound does not include the comparison with 2a
reason: The row-lengths page bounds the diagram row by main+slack. The additional inequality main+slack≤2a, used both for the analytic exponent and for the per-box cost 25 log b, comes from a separate size estimate in ArchimedeanSize.lean.
proposed_correction: Supply the one-line argument that slack≤b+offWeight+halfGap²≤a by the data scales and main≤a, or cite rowMainLength_add_rowSlack_le explicitly.

title: Distinguish a ramified vector from this stronger witness
reason: The gloss on “ramified vector” requires the scalar to equal 1 at the other places. The definition requires only that its reduction modulo N equal 1 there. Exact equality holds for the scaling chosen in this proof, as the support argument shows. The link New.ramified also omits IsSplitLevel.
proposed_correction: State the residue condition as the definition, then observe that this proof chooses a scalar equal to 1 away from w. Link the ramified-vector-at-split-level knowl, and qualify the related upOperator and mirabolic_fix_upOperator links with New.IsSplitLevel.

title: The cycle axiom permits algebraic twists
reason: The motivation states that the maps g↦ιₛ(g) are nonalgebraic. The axiom requires only a Frobenius congruence. For W=R=𝔽₂₅, p=P=5 and N=2, the identity and entrywise fifth power are polynomial maps satisfying it, with w=0.
proposed_correction: Say that the cycle gives no general algebraic formula for the maps. This motivates the generic-matrix construction and also covers the algebraic special cases.

title: The logarithmic bound needs a degree-zero case
reason: The proof applies floor(logₚ(n+m)) when n=m=0, which satisfies 0<p^f for every allowed f. The ordinary logarithm is undefined at zero. The source uses the natural-number logarithm, which handles this case.
proposed_correction: Handle n+m=0 first using the binomial coefficient 1, then apply the logarithmic estimate for n+m≥1.

title: Coincident root indices have a single combined weight
reason: Part 1 allows a=a′. In this case Xₛ=Yₛ, so the stated individual weights ±P^[s−i]/(q−1) are two contributions to one coordinate. The coordinate actually has weight 0 away from i and weight 1 at i. The telescoping identity still holds.
proposed_correction: Handle a=a′ first, when both sides are (St ν)(a,i), or describe the signed terms as indicator contributions that add when the indices coincide.

title: The individual weight formulas assume a≠a′
reason: The opening proof line assigns two different values to ω(Yₛ) and ω(Xₛ) even though part 2 explicitly allows Xₛ=Yₛ. For equal indices their common weight is 0 away from i and 1 at i. The proof later uses the correct difference of indicator contributions.
proposed_correction: Place the two equalities inside the proof of part 1 under a≠a′. For part 2 start from the difference-of-indicators formula.

title: Precision zero uses a truncated predecessor
reason: The definition permits c=0, for which the displayed w^(c−1) is an inverse that a valuation domain need not contain. The natural-number exponent in the source is zero in that case, so property 5 applies directly to h∈C.
proposed_correction: Write w^max(c−1,0) in property 5, or spell out its c=0 case. Define the pairing exponent c₀=k²fN alongside the other parameters.

title: The lattice illustration omits its uniformizer assumption
reason: The geometric change of basis uses a diagonal matrix with entries p⁻¹. The source’s geometric model explicitly makes p a uniformizer of W, while the knowl only assumes a local ring W. For instance its algebraic definition permits W to be a finite field of characteristic p, where the displayed p⁻¹ has no meaning.
proposed_correction: Introduce the illustrative lattice construction by assuming p is a uniformizer of W and read the diagonal matrix over its fraction field.

title: Quotients of dimension r require r≤k
reason: The definition permits r>k. In that range the parahoric is all of GLₖ and its coset set is a singleton, whereas a residue-vector-space quotient of a rank-k lattice cannot have dimension r. The source qualifies the geometric interpretation by r≤k.
proposed_correction: Add r≤k to the sentence identifying the cosets with geometric edges.

title: The linked divided-power stability proof has additional hypotheses
reason: The remark asserts stability of both lattices for an arbitrary coefficient ring. The linked theorem proves the assertion for the divided-power lattice assuming O is a characteristic-zero domain. Its proof cancels factorials, which need not be cancellable over the ring stated here.

title: The abstract image need not be a lattice
